# E0407: a field that is not part of a lacuna

A lacuna has a fixed set of fields: condition, sourceFields, targetFields,
message and type. A field outside that set is usually a typo; the help names
the closest.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				a:  string
				b?: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.1->0.0": {
		input: _
		result: {
			a: input.a
		}
		lacunas: [
			{type: "DroppedField", message: "b was dropped", condition: input.b != _|_, severity: 1},
		]
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0407]: severity is not a field of a lacuna
  --> lineage.cue:24:80
   |
24 |             {type: "DroppedField", message: "b was dropped", condition: input.b != _|_, severity: 1},
   |                                                                                         ^^^^^^^^
   |
   = detail: lenses.0.1->0.0.lacunas.0.severity: severity is not a field of a lacuna; a lacuna has only condition, sourceFields, targetFields, message and type
   = help: a lacuna has only condition, sourceFields, targetFields, message, type
```
